title: Nucleotide resolution profiling of m3C RNA modification by HAC-seq
boundary: High-salt hydrazine followed by aniline creates m3C-dependent RNA cuts; end-repaired/AlkB-controlled libraries sequence retained full-length and3prime cleavage fragments. Different chemical initiation/substrate selectivity from registered alkaline-depurination AlkAniline-seq and U-cleavage HydraPsiSeq.
evidence_scope: Primary published article identity and experimental-design/Fig2 overview inspected; full source/version/supplement/oligo pass pending. No registration or collection count.

title: Antibody-free enzyme-assisted chemical approach for detection of N6-methyladenosine
boundary: FTO-assisted oxidative activation and chemical labeling permits affinity capture of m6A-containingRNA before sequencing. Different source substrate/product/capture from direct MeRIP, DART editing or SAC allylation; same-label followups remain one method.
evidence_scope: Publisher primary identity and primary PubMed abstract32341502 inspected; complete reaction recipe/endpoints and supplements unreviewed. No registration or collection count.

title: A metabolic labeling method detects m6A transcriptome-wide at single base resolution
boundary: Metabolic Se-allyl-L-selenohomocysteine supplies allyl rather than methyl to cellular methylation machinery; installed a6A is iodinated to yield mutationalRT readout. Distinct metabolic substrate generation from in-vitro selective SAC modification of existingm6A.
evidence_scope: Primary published PubMed identity/abstract inspected; publisher main redirect blocked here. STARProtocols2022 detailed same-method companion is not another entry; actual full preparation pending.

title: Transcriptome-wide mapping reveals a diverse dihydrouridine landscape including mRNA
boundary: Sodium-borohydride-dependent D reduction creates RT-blocking RNA and stranded cDNA-end libraries. Different reduced chemical substrate and RT-stop product from Rho-seq dye adducts; not a new organism application of the same recipe.
evidence_scope: Primary PLOS abstract and initial chemistry/library schematic overview inspected. MethodsEnzymol2023 DOI10.1016/bs.mie.2023.09.001 is same-method detailed companion, not extra entry. Full curation pending.

title: Transcription-wide mapping of dihydrouridine reveals that mRNA dihydrouridylation is required for meiotic chromosome segregation
boundary: Modification-dependent rhodamine derivatization creates RT-blocking RNA adducts and corresponding sequencing endpoints; distinct from D-seq reduction-only RT-stop substrate. Genotype/mock conditions do not constitute extra protocols.
evidence_scope: Published primary Cell summary/highlights and associatedPMC8792297 selected overview inspected. Detailed STARProtocols2022 DOI10.1016/j.xpro.2022.101369 same method. No full chemistry/absence review.

title: High-throughput single-base resolution mapping of RNA 2′-O-methylated residues
boundary: Paired low/highdNTP random-primedRT prepares different cDNA-stop populations; cDNA adapter ligation preserves RT endpoints. Distinct from registered periodate-selectedNm RNA fragments and alkaline-cleavage protection RiboMethSeq.
evidence_scope: Primary published abstract, initialResults and Fig1 library overview inspected; exact full oligo/source and supplemental alternative library route unreviewed. Full curation pending.

title: Nm-Mut-seq: a base-resolution quantitative method for mapping transcriptome-wide 2′-O-methylation
boundary: EvolvedRT-41B4 and restrictive nucleotide conditions encode Nm as cDNA misincorporations. Source-defined changed product/readout chemistry versus 2OMe-seq terminatedcDNA, not merely an enzyme substitution claimed on name alone. Um detection limitation retained for later source review.
evidence_scope: Primary publisher/PubMed37316584 identity and primaryPMC10474006 Fig1 overview inspected; direct PMC open subsequently challenged. Full original/supplement/quantitation review pending.

title: An integrative platform for detection of RNA 2′-O-methylation reveals its broad distribution on mRNA
boundary: FragmentedRNA receives a3prime tail before MgR RNaseR3prime-to5prime digestion; Nm-sensitive digestion produces retained fragment ends atNm+1 for sequencing. Different physical digestion/retained-end construction from periodateNm capture, RT stops or mutationalRT. Nm-VAQ is a companion validation assay, not separateNGS entry.
evidence_scope: Primary published identity, summary and initialResults/Fig1C preparation overview inspected. Prior2019bioRxivpreprint not separate entry or preferred authority; full recipe/supplement review pending.
